## Description

The kernel cannot construct a clean inside/outside classification because the void hierarchy is malformed: a region the inner void declares "solid material" the outer void declares "empty space". Bug-reporter language: "nested cavities", "voids inside voids", "shell inside another shell".

## Reproducer recipe

`BREP_WITH_VOIDS` with `voids` referencing two `ORIENTED_CLOSED_SHELL` entries; the inner void's bounding box is geometrically contained in the outer void's bounding box.
